correctness.rationale: Re-executed the full evidence chain independently. Recompiled inputs/artifacts/enum.c with OpenMP and re-ran (4 threads): reproduced SUBTOTAL(row0 fixed)=1969680, TOTAL x35=68938800, MIN 24 in every one of the 35 row-1 classes, WIT [7,7,25,26,100,104,112], and HIST-SUB 24:412560, 25:181440, 26:725760, 27:483840, 30:90720, 31:51840, 32:22680, 54:840, which x35 equals the claimed labeled distribution and sums to 68938800. Ran inputs/artifacts/verify.py -> VERIFY_OK: witness margins all 3, brute-force 5040-permutation permanent 24, independent Ryser permanent 24, Schrijver (4/3)^7=16384/2187, exact ratio 6561/2048, distribution sum 68938800. Independently rechecked in C (Heap's 5040 perms, 25.4M S7xS7 pairs): witness permanent 24, stabilizer order 16, orbit size 5040^2/16=1587600. Verified Ryser code logic (S=1..127 accumulation with sign (-1)^|S|, return -s for n=7 odd; empty set contributes 0), column-symmetry factor 35=C(7,3) transitivity justification, and sound column-cap/capacity pruning. Verified arithmetic: 24*2187/16384=6561/2048~3.2036; distribution sums exactly to 68938800. DRAFT honestly scopes the proved claims (count, minimum, distribution, witness+permanent, ratio, one orbit size) and explicitly leaves the number of minimizer orbits open, so no complete-orbit claim is made.

originality.rationale: Substantive comparison, not timestamp/search-failure. Live-fetched OEIS A001501: publishes only labeled counts (n=7,k=3 is 68938800) with formulas/references, no permanents, minima, minimizers, or distribution. Live-fetched OEIS A000166: derangement permanents per(J-I) !5=44,!6=265,!7=1854,!8=14833; J-I has row sum 6 at n=7 so structurally excluded by fixed margin 3. Live-fetched MathWorld Permanent: publishes only the general Ryser evaluation formula, not any D(7,3) minimum. Schrijver 1998 (doi:10.1006/jctb.1997.1798) is the general k-regular lower bound against which sharpness is measured, not an exhaustive D(7,3) minimum/orbit/distribution. OEIS text search 'minimum permanent regular' returns only Catalan, no regular-permanent minimum sequence. Internal nearest SCOPE040 covers disjoint class D(6,3) (minimum 17). No source publishes m(7,3)=24, the witness, the 8-value distribution with gaps 28,29,33-53 absent and isolated 54:29400, or stabilizer 16.

value.rationale: Headline is a rigorously established exact invariant of a natural object meeting the exact-invariant clause: D(7,3) (7x7 (0,1)-matrices, all margins 3) is the canonical next odd-order case of the recognized Schrijver/Voorhoeve minimum-permanent (perfect matchings of k-regular bipartite graphs) program motivated before computation; m(7,3)=24 with explicit minimizer, full 8-value distribution summing to 68938800, and exact Schrijver ratio 6561/2048 were not known or mechanically implied (regularity only forces per>0 by Hall/Konig); future work on regular-bipartite permanents, Bregman-Minc bounds, and matching-enumeration benchmarks can cite the precise minimum, witness, stabilizer/orbit size, and distribution. Not a textbook restatement, parameter substitution without new phenomenon (odd-order regime, distribution gaps, isolated 54 mass), tiny gain, or unexplained enumeration. The admittedly incomplete minimizer-orbit census is described honestly and does not erase the independently valuable exact minimum/distribution/witness headline.
